one_liner: Senior Treasury manager running a team that advises foreign finance ministries on budgeting, public financial management, and financial accountability reforms.
fit_summary: This GS-15 role requires one year at the GS-14 equivalent covering all three areas: direct supervision, managing international technical assistance projects for developing-country governments, and senior public financial management experience. From what is on file, Daniel's background is domestic emergency management consulting and policy knowledge, not international PFM assistance or staff supervision. Unless Daniel's IEM work included supervising staff and international government capacity-building on budgets or finance, Daniel is unlikely to be rated qualified.
eligibility: Open to the public (U.S. citizens and nationals) and to CTAP/ICTAP-eligible federal employees, so no prior federal status is needed.

One year of specialized experience at the GS-14 equivalent must cover all three areas: (1) direct supervisory management of staff or teams, (2) identifying, developing, or managing international technical assistance projects, and (3) public sector financial management or government financial accountability.
A Secret security clearance is required, so you must pass a background investigation and the hiring office will check suitability.
A one-year supervisory probationary period may apply, and you would need to file a Confidential Financial Disclosure Report within 30 days of appointment, if applicable.
keywords: coordinate with other U.S. agencies and international organizations
strategy: Before investing time, honestly check whether you can document 52 weeks covering all three specialized-experience areas. If you can't, target GS-11 to GS-13 emergency management, grants, or policy roles at FEMA or DHS instead.

If the IEM role involved managing grant funds, disaster recovery budgets, or financial accountability for government clients, frame it in PFM terms such as budget execution, internal controls, and audit readiness, but only where it is accurate.
State any staff supervision explicitly: how many people, hiring, mentoring, and assigning work. Supervision is a mandatory element of the specialized experience.
Keep the resume to two pages, list dates as month/day/year with hours per week, and mirror the posting's keywords.

Answer the questionnaire truthfully, because the cut-off score is 90 and overstating can remove you. Prepare for the Federal Supervisor Assessment, which covers accountability, decisiveness, interpersonal skills, and similar competencies.
The window runs from 10/22/2026 to 11/05/2026, so submit several days before closing and confirm the online assessment is completed.
resume_bullets: Supervised [number] staff on [IEM project/client], assigning work, mentoring, and evaluating performance to deliver [deliverable] for [government client]. ([dates], [hours]/week)
Developed work plans, budgets, and performance measures for [project] totaling [$ amount], supporting [government client]'s [budget execution/financial accountability/grant compliance] requirements.
Prepared briefing papers and memoranda for [senior officials] and coordinated with [agencies/organizations] to align [recovery/preparedness] assistance priorities.
interview_questions: Describe an international technical assistance project you designed or managed, including how you assessed counterpart commitment.
How have you supervised and developed a team of technical experts or advisors?
Walk us through your experience with government budget formulation, execution, or financial controls.
How would you brief a senior Treasury official on a struggling project and coordinate with other U.S. agencies?
watch_outs: The required international PFM technical assistance experience does not appear in Daniel's known background, so a 'not qualified' rating is likely.
Direct supervisory experience is mandatory and is not documented for Daniel.
The Secret clearance and financial disclosure add time to hiring, and the role requires some travel plus a commute from Manassas to DC despite telework eligibility.
The application window is only two weeks and includes an online assessment.
